title: Corpus Overwhelm
definition: The felt experience at holistic-synthesis moments (gates, architecture review, onboarding, re-entry after time away, graduation) when the count of mutually-referencing artifacts that must be held simultaneously exceeds working capacity. Mechanism: Sweller's element interactivity (C2); moment-independent, with graduation the widest-scope case, not a different case. Two components with different remedies: reading load (per-item cost; addressed by Surface Views and gate tooling) and Adjudication Load (item count; not addressed by either).
product_origin: "it takes a long time and it's a lot of text to read"; "no one reads them" (Solo Developer, 2026-09-03 and research log §User reframing)

links.note: the reading-load component (per-item cost) via Surface Views
the Adjudication Load component (item count) via rules 1–5; reading load in the conversation via rules 6–7
